defs.meaning: （职业的）作家，作者；执笔者，撰写人（writer 的复数）

examples.en: Few writers approach his richness of language.
examples.zh: 他语言之丰富很少有作家能望其项背。

examples.en: These cases all attracted flocks of famous writers.
examples.zh: 这些案例均吸引了大批知名作家。

examples.en: Many writers at this time held rigidly dogmatic views.
examples.zh: 许多作家这一时期刻板地固守教条主义的观点。
